# Samin Yeasar (SOLEZ / Solez-ai / SOLEZ-AI / solez.ai) — Full Stack Developer & Solo Founder

## About
Full Stack Developer and solo founder known as SOLEZ (Solez-ai, SOLEZ-AI, solez.ai) building MentorMind — introducing a new culture of help to Bangladesh. Specializing in React, TypeScript, Rust, Node.js, and modern web development.

## Notable Projects
- **3 Drag Win**: Windows utility for three-finger touchpad window dragging (Rust, C++, WinAPI). Star project demonstrating systems-level programming.
- **Nodex**: Browser-native data visualization platform (React, TypeScript, Supabase). Paste or upload data and explore through interactive graph and tree visualizations.
- **Vell**: Reactive document markup language (Rust, WebAssembly, TypeScript). Parses to a deterministic AST in linear time, compiles to HTML5 or PDF, includes LSP server and formatter.
- **URLPad**: Browser-based text editor using URL hash (Vanilla JS). Every note is private, portable, and instantly shareable without a backend.
- **PySketch**: Visual programming platform for Python Turtle graphics (Next.js, React). Transforms freehand sketches into executable Python code.
